In [[geometry]], the '''diminished rhombicosidodecahedron''' is one of the [[Johnson solid]]s ({{math|''J''{{sub|76}}}}). It can be constructed as a [[rhombicosidodecahedron]] with one [[pentagonal cupola]] removed.
[[File:J76 diminished rhombicosidodecahedron.stl|thumb|3D model of a diminished rhombicosidodecahedron]]
{{Johnson solid}}

Related Johnson solids are:
* {{math|''J''{{sub|80}}}}: [[parabidiminished rhombicosidodecahedron]] with two opposing cupolae removed, and
* {{math|''J''{{sub|81}}}}: [[metabidiminished rhombicosidodecahedron]] with two non-opposing cupolae removed, and
* {{math|''J''{{sub|83}}}}: [[tridiminished rhombicosidodecahedron]] with three cupola removed.
